##: pen.dev, the agentic design canvas of High Agency, Inc.; the vendor page is https://www.pen.dev/.

The downloads page's Windows button serves https://www.pen.dev/download/Pen-win-x64.exe, which answers 302 to a five-minute signed URL on the private GCS bucket pencil-desktop-releases. The object name carries no version, so that URL cannot pin a release.

resources/app-update.yml inside the payload points the bundled electron-updater at the GitHub repository highagency/pen-desktop-releases, and that repository publishes versioned artifacts for every release. The manifest therefore pins the versioned GitHub asset; the redirecting /download/Pen-win-x64.exe served the same bytes at the time of writing (SHA-256 0da01b60229f82176c5ceb2730f9c84bd3f70407e344ff2b1e4cc85126bd3ccf).
The version is confirmed twice inside the payload: resources/app.asar reports package.json version 1.2.23, and the NSIS stub's PE metadata reports FileVersion 1.2.23.

The installer is NSIS-3 Unicode: $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z holds the 236-entry app flat, with Pen.exe at the root, and $R0 only carries 'Uninstall Pen.exe'. The installer script expands the payload into $dir and drops both folders.
Only win-x64 is published for Windows; the downloads page lists the ARM64 build as 'coming soon' and the release carries no such asset.
checkver uses the GitHub API, which returns tag_name v1.2.23 for the version group. autoupdate.hash is omitted on purpose, so Scoop reads the sha256 digest that the same API publishes for each asset.
description: Agentic design canvas for building interfaces with AI agents
notes: The NSIS stubs ($PLUGINSDIR and the bundled 'Uninstall Pen.exe') are dropped, so Scoop owns the uninstall.

User data lives outside the app directory: the config folder and the .pen document store under "$env:USERPROFILE\.pencil", the Chromium profile under "$env:APPDATA%\Pen", and the updater cache in "$env:LOCALAPPDATA%\pen-updater".

The bundled electron-updater stays enabled and pulls builds from highagency/pen-desktop-releases. An in-app update runs the vendor installer, which installs a per-user copy outside the Scoop app directory instead of replacing it; run 'scoop install pen -f' afterwards to return to the packaged build.
The 428 MiB download unpacks to about 1.5 GB, because resources\app.asar.unpacked bundles the Claude Agent SDK, the OpenAI Codex CLI, Cursor tooling and a local MCP server for agent connections.
